headline: USDA to Deploy AI Tool for Crop Production Reports After Data Errors
summary: The US Department of Agriculture announced it will use an in-house artificial intelligence tool to check data for its upcoming monthly crop production report following recent missteps that eroded market trust.
why: USDA crop reports are key market-moving benchmarks for global agricultural commodities; data errors can cause sudden volatility and disrupt trader confidence.

impacts.name: Agricultural Commodities
impacts.why: Improved accuracy in USDA forecasts reduces unexpected volatility for grain and crop traders.
